name: Mindfulness for depression
description: Randomised trials of mindfulness-based interventions in adults with depression. Decoys include anxiety-only and adolescent studies.

records.title: Mindfulness-based stress reduction in adults with major depressive disorder: a randomised controlled trial (Aarhus cohort 17)
records.abstract: Background: Evidence for Mindfulness-based stress reduction in major depressive disorder is limited. Methods: In this double-blind trial, 343 adults (aged 18-80) with major depressive disorder were randomised to Mindfulness-based stress reduction or a waitlist control for 8 weeks. The primary outcome was PHQ-9 score. Results: No significant difference in PHQ-9 score was observed (p = 0.21). Conclusion: Results support further study.
